description: Knowledge Graph - Port the KnowledgeManager from munder-difflin/src/main/knowledge.ts. File-backed knowledge store with ingest, search (BM25), CRUD, and stats. Uses existing BM25 retriever from nexus.memory.retriever.
steps: Create src/nexus/knowledge/graph_types.py with Pydantic models: KgMeta (id: str, title: str, source: str, modality: str default 'text', mime: str|None, bytes_: int, tags: list[str], caption: str|None, chunk_count: int, added_at: str), KgHit (doc_id: str, title: str, source: str, chunk_idx: int, score: float, snippet: str), IngestResult (doc_id: str, chunk_count: int, meta: KgMeta), KnowledgeStatus (enabled: bool, root: str, doc_count: int, chunk_count: int, by_modality: dict[str, int]).

Create src/nexus/knowledge/graph.py with KnowledgeManager class. Constructor takes root: str (the directory for storage). Directory layout: <root>/index.json (list of KgMeta entries), <root>/chunks/<doc_id>/ (per-document chunk files as .txt). Methods: ingest_file(src_path, title=None, tags=None, caption=None) reads file and delegates to _ingest_content. ingest_text(text, title=None, tags=None) delegates to _ingest_content. _ingest_content(content, title, source, tags, mime, modality) generates doc_id (uuid), chunks the content (paragraph-based, configurable chunk_size default 500), writes chunks to disk, updates index.json, returns IngestResult. search(query, limit=10) loads all chunks, uses BM25 from nexus.memory.retriever (tokenize + bm25_score + search functions), returns top KgHit results. list_docs() returns all KgMeta from index. get_doc(doc_id) returns meta + full text (reconstructed from chunks). remove_doc(doc_id) removes from index and deletes chunk directory. stats() returns KnowledgeStatus with counts by modality.

Create tests/test_knowledge_graph.py with comprehensive tests using tmp_path fixture: test ingest_text creates index.json and chunk files, test ingest_file reads from disk, test search returns relevant hits scored by BM25, test search with no results returns empty list, test list_docs returns all ingested docs, test get_doc returns full text, test get_doc for unknown returns None, test remove_doc removes from index and disk, test remove_doc for unknown returns False, test stats counts correctly, test multiple ingests with different modalities counted in by_modality.
acceptance_criteria: All type models importable from nexus.knowledge.graph_types
ingest_text and ingest_file create proper directory structure with index.json and chunk files
search uses BM25 from nexus.memory.retriever and returns ranked results
list_docs, get_doc, remove_doc, stats all work correctly
All tests pass with pytest tests/test_knowledge_graph.py
verification: pytest tests/ (full suite to confirm no regressions)
findings: All 31 tests pass. Full suite (1535 tests) passes with no regressions. Used datetime.UTC alias per ruff UP017 rule. KgMeta bytes_ field uses Pydantic alias='bytes' with populate_by_name=True for proper serialization. Ruff auto-fix needed for import ordering in tests.
